assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserving sprite animation edit. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET and the exact identity reference: ROSE / wanderer_7, chestnut hair in two round buns, dusty rose jacket with plum trim, charcoal trousers and brown boots, expressive heart-shaped head. Preserve this EXACT character's face, hairstyle, outfit, colors, head-to-body ratio, hand-drawn scratchy ink outlines and hatching. Do not redesign her. Make a NEW supplementary transparent animation atlas, NOT a copy of the original sheet layout. Portrait canvas 1024x1536. EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 15 separate complete full-body poses. Every cell has generous fully transparent gutters; no pose overlaps another cell. Keep each standing body approximately 240 pixels tall and its proportions consistent. Column 1 SOUTH/front, column 2 NORTH/back with absolutely no visible face, column 3 EAST/right-facing profile.
Rows top to bottom:
1 WALK PASSING LEFT: right leg supports the body vertically directly under the pelvis, left knee lifts slightly forward with its foot passing close to the supporting ankle. Narrow passing-step silhouette with both feet under the body, not a long stride. Opposing natural arms.
2 WALK PASSING RIGHT: the exact opposite supporting foot and lifted knee, left leg supports under the pelvis, right knee/foot passes forward. Clearly different from row 1, same facing columns.
3 ALTERNATE RUN FLIGHT: new full-speed airborne long stride on the OPPOSITE legs/arms from the original sheet's running row. Clearly extended left leg forward and right leg behind, opposite arm swing, slight forward lean; keep full feet and hair inside the cell.
4 STANDING HURT RECOIL: standing stagger with torso and head leaning backward, knees slightly bent but hips high, one empty hand guarding chest and other balancing. Startled expression in front/side views. Never kneel, squat, sit or reach toward the ground.
5 STANDING DOWNWARD SWING FOLLOW-THROUGH: after a downward axe/pickaxe swing with empty hands, leading hand extended diagonally downward in front of waist, torso leaning forward only about 15 degrees, feet planted in a staggered standing stance, hips high. This is a standing working/attack recovery pose, NOT crouching, kneeling, sitting or bare-hand gathering.
No held weapon or tool, no armor overlays, no effects, no text, no labels, no grid, no border, no extra poses. TRUE alpha background, fully transparent outside each silhouette, no colored backdrop, no gradient, no halo, no drop shadows, no ground or ground shadow. Preserve original ink cut-paper look; no pixelation, no smooth vector rendering, no 3D.
assets.repair_prompt: Edit ONLY ROW THREE of the attached three-column five-row transparent character atlas. Keep ALL other rows, character identity, colors, face, outfit, line style, sizes and transparent gutters unchanged. Row three currently repeats the same leading-side run as the original. Replace the three row-three poses with a clearly CONTRALATERAL RUNNING FLIGHT pose: the arm nearest the camera sweeps BEHIND the torso, the far arm reaches FORWARD; the leg nearest the camera extends BEHIND, and the far leg extends FORWARD. This is the opposite limb phase of the supplied row-three run. For south/front view show the viewer-left leg stretched forward with the viewer-right leg swept back, and opposite arm swing; back view preserves the same anatomical phase; right-facing profile uses near arm behind and far arm forward. Exaggerate the changed limb silhouette enough for an alternating game run cycle. Both feet airborne, clear negative space between legs. No floor, shadow, effects, tools, labels, grids, extra poses or background. Preserve original transparent alpha outside silhouettes. Exactly 3 columns x 5 rows on 1024x1536.
